Engine & forms · Compatibility · Browser behavior · Reports & automated tests

Compare both engines. On macOS, press Command-E to switch between Assembly and WebKit. Use Back to return here. Resize the window to check wrapping and responsive layout. JavaScript-only checks are marked below.

Engine & forms

Forms, images & linked stylesheets

GET/POST submission, Unicode, checkboxes, radio buttons, selects, textareas, missing images and external CSS.

Layout gallery

Flexbox sizing, wrapping, tables, CSS variables and SVG.

Floats & clear

Text wrapping around floats, clearing and container geometry.

CSS & typography

Selectors, cascade, inheritance, fonts, colors, hidden content and text alignment.

HTML & navigation basics

Entities, Unicode, headings, lists, preformatted text and relative links.

Acid1

CSS1 layout test. Compare with the reference image.

Background images & media lists

Stylesheet media alternatives, relative image URLs, sizing, positioning, tiling, rounded clipping and native button backgrounds.

Input geometry & editing

CSS form outlines, field padding, vertical centering and live editing without native bezels or focus rings.

The report contains saved screenshots, geometry checks and timing budgets from the last local run. It is not a live test result.

Tests that run from the terminal

The native harnesses cover SQLite, URL handling, HTML/DOM/CSS, display lists, text layout, forms, shortcuts, resource loading and navigation. They are not standalone web pages.

./build.sh test
./tools/test-linux.sh
sh tools/compatibility-report.sh

Run the Linux integration script in the Linux build environment. The compatibility report requires Apple silicon macOS.
